bucket_smartplan_desc: Personal study plans for each student, built with your own AI assistant
locked_smartplanner_title: Smart Planner is turned off for this workbook
locked_smartplanner_desc: Smart Planner turns your class marks, chapters and teacher remarks into a personal study plan for each student. You create a prompt here, paste it into any AI chat assistant you like, and bring the result back to get one PDF report per student. Student names and the school name are never put in the prompt.
smartplan_intro: Pick the tests to include, generate a prompt, run it in your own AI assistant, then upload its result to get a study-plan PDF for every student. Only student IDs ever leave StudIn - never names or the school name.
smartplan_card1_hint: A student is included if they have marks in at least one ticked test. Ticking more tests never removes anyone.
smartplan_no_tests_checked: Tick at least one test to see which students can be included.
smartplan_excluded_reason: No marks recorded for any selected test. They are left out of the prompt.
smartplan_prompt_ready: Prompt downloaded: {{fname}}. Paste it into your AI assistant, then upload its result in step 2.
smartplan_card2_title: 2. Upload the AI result and build reports
smartplan_card2_hint: Upload the .txt file your AI assistant gives you for the prompt you just generated.
smartplan_upload_need_prompt: Generate a prompt first. The result must belong to that prompt.
smartplan_err_read: The file could not be read. Please try again.
smartplan_err_token_mismatch: This result belongs to a different Smart Planner prompt. Its validation code does not match the prompt you generated in this session, so reports are blocked. Upload the result for the prompt you just generated, or generate a new prompt.
smartplan_err_token_missing: This file does not look like a Smart Planner result: the validation code is missing from the top of the file. Reports are blocked. Ask your AI assistant to follow the prompt's output format exactly.
smartplan_missing: Missing from the result: {{ids}}. Regenerate or re-run the prompt before continuing.
smartplan_flagged: {{n}} student(s) had a chapter claim that did not match the logged data. Those claims are left out of their PDF.
smartplan_rail_empty: Tick a test to list the students who can be included.
